summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration 21 (loyalty gifts, exclusive offers, tier bug fix, checkout gift-code, admin loyalty panel & 8 theme presets). Setup done via API (admin login + PUT /api/settings with BRONZE gift [product+custom] + 20% BRONZE offer + fresh customer @200pts). Verified end-to-end in the browser: (1) /compte shows profile-tier-badge='Statut BRONZE'. (2) /fidelite renders loyalty-gifts, gift-tier-BRONZE, 2 gift options; clicking gift-claim-* produced gift-code-BRONZE='CADEAU-B1595C' (correct format); after reload only gift-claimed-BRONZE is visible and 0 claim buttons -> one-gift-per-tier enforced. (3) loyalty-offers section rendered with offer-add-{id}; click adds product at member price. (4) /commande gift-code-input auto-filled; order placed => confirmation page contains '🎁'; GET /orders/mine shows two line items: base product at member-priced 2528 DA + '🎁 Eucerin Bandages Advanced' at price 0 (gift free, offer discount + gift both applied). (5) TIER BUG: after PUT loyalty_tiers with BRONZE min=500 (customer=200pts) badge on /compte changes to 'Nouveau membre' with neutral style; GET /loyalty/me returns tier=null; admin GET /customers list returns tier=null too. (6) Admin UI (/admin -> admin-tab-loyalty): admin-loyalty-panel + gift-product-search + tier-0-gift-add-custom + tier-0-gift-name-* + offer-add + offer-title/type/value/-tier-BRONZE + loyalty-save all present and functional. (7) admin-tab-settings shows all 8 theme-preset-{0..7} with name/accent/bg color inputs and apply buttons; theme-manual dropdown lists 4 seasons + 8 preset ids. Direct PUT theme_mode=manual + theme_manual=rose_ivoire yields --mint-600=#b52632 and --mint-50=#FDF8F5 site-wide on / with header/buttons/badges taking the rose palette and layout intact. Settings reset to auto+defaults at end. No critical UI defects found.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in the Wilaya select (Checkout.jsx line 244). Cosmetic — does not break UX but should be fixed by rendering `{w.code} — {w.name}` directly without wrapping the expression in a <span>.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Fix the option hydration warning in /commande Wilaya select (Checkout.jsx ~line 244) by not wrapping the label expression in a <span> inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is now 1727 lines — split LoyaltyAdminPanel, SettingsPanel, ChatAdminPanel, AnalyticsPanel into /pages/admin/*.jsx for maintainability.

GiftProductAdd inline component only exposes gift-product-search but not gift-product-result-{id} (the spec calls those out). Currently product results render as generic <button> — consider adding data-testid={`gift-product-result-${p.id}`} to each result row for E2E stability.
Loyalty save() strips out gifts whose name is empty (custom gift without name) silently — a toast warning would improve UX so admins know their empty custom rows were dropped.
SettingsPanel.save() PUTs the ENTIRE settings object (~all fields) on every save; consider sending only diff or split by section to avoid overwriting unrelated fields under concurrent edits.
applyPresetVars sets 10 CSS vars via inline style; wrapping them under a class name (e.g., theme-custom) with CSS variable declarations would be more idiomatic but current approach works.

Account.jsx line 152 renders the badge only if tier is truthy; because r.data?.tier?.name || '__new__' returns a string, this works — but if loyalty is disabled the badge is silently hidden, which is fine but could be documented.
